On this page
PATCH News Lockout

Turn the global news lockout on or off. While it is on, opening webhook signals are blocked from preMinutes before to postMinutes after each matching economic event.

ELITE

The Management API requires an Elite subscription. See Authentication.

Endpoint​

PATCH https://app.crosstrade.io/v1/api/manage/news-lockout

Headers​
NAME	REQUIRED	VALUE
Authorization	Yes	Bearer <your API token>
Content-Type	Yes	application/json
If-Match	No	ETag from a previous read
Body parameters​
NAME	TYPE	REQUIRED	DESCRIPTION
enabled	boolean	No	Turn the news lockout on or off

impact, currencies, preMinutes and postMinutes are read-only here, as in the web app, and your saved values are kept. You can send them back as you read them (matching values are ignored), but a value that differs from the saved one returns 422 field_read_only.

Code examples​
Python
cURL
import requests



resp = requests.patch(

    "https://app.crosstrade.io/v1/api/manage/news-lockout",

    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"},

    json={"enabled": True},

)

print(resp.json())

Responses​
200
Other errors
{

  "success": true,

  "changed": true,

  "data": { "enabled": true, "impact": ["high"], "currencies": ["USD"], "preMinutes": 5, "postMinutes": 5 },

  "changedFields": ["enabled"],

  "delivery": { "status": "immediate", "target": "signal_gate" },

  "warnings": [],

  "meta": { "requestId": "req_9f2c1a0b7d3e4f51", "etag": "\"c2:Tm90UmVhbEV0YWcwMg\"" }

}

When it takes effect​

The next incoming webhook signal. The lockout applies to webhook signals only.

Notes​
News settings on individual monitors (newsLockout on a monitor) are separate and are not changed here.
